# usage

=== step 1: dashcrew
exit: 0
stdout:
| Agent-agnostic AI coding toolkit with Flutter built in.
| 
| Usage: dashcrew <command> [arguments]
| 
| Global options:
| -h, --help       Print this usage information.
|     --version    Print the dashcrew version.
| 
| Available commands:
|   check       Merge gate for a pull request: toolkit current, PR sections present, commits in the pattern. Writes nothing.
|   commit      Commit messages in the team's pattern (project.commit): a ready command, and a lint. Never commits.
|   doctor      Check that the generated toolkit is installed, untouched and current. Writes nothing.
|   guard       Check one agent tool call: hook JSON on stdin, the answer on stdout or stderr and in the exit code.
|   init        Detect the platform and stack and write .ai/project.yaml. Writes nothing else.
|   knowledge   Shared product knowledge: scaffold the repo, keep its clone current, review proposals, find stale pages.
|   link        Point a dependency in project.links at a local checkout. Writes only a git-excluded file.
|   platform    Platform starters: write a platform into .ai/platforms/<name>/ for the team to edit. Writes once.
|   release     Release lines from project.release_lines. Reads git only.
|   spec        Feature specs (PRD and TRD) in the knowledge repo: scaffold, lint, revise and status. Never runs git write commands.
|   sync        Render rules, roles, skills, guard and hooks for the agents in .ai/project.yaml.
|   verify      Helpers for the verify workflow.
|   worktree    One worktree per parallel task. Never commits, pushes or deletes a branch.
| 
| Run "dashcrew help <command>" for more information about a command.
stderr: (empty)
files: (unchanged)

=== step 2: dashcrew "--help"
exit: 0
stdout:
| Agent-agnostic AI coding toolkit with Flutter built in.
| 
| Usage: dashcrew <command> [arguments]
| 
| Global options:
| -h, --help       Print this usage information.
|     --version    Print the dashcrew version.
| 
| Available commands:
|   check       Merge gate for a pull request: toolkit current, PR sections present, commits in the pattern. Writes nothing.
|   commit      Commit messages in the team's pattern (project.commit): a ready command, and a lint. Never commits.
|   doctor      Check that the generated toolkit is installed, untouched and current. Writes nothing.
|   guard       Check one agent tool call: hook JSON on stdin, the answer on stdout or stderr and in the exit code.
|   init        Detect the platform and stack and write .ai/project.yaml. Writes nothing else.
|   knowledge   Shared product knowledge: scaffold the repo, keep its clone current, review proposals, find stale pages.
|   link        Point a dependency in project.links at a local checkout. Writes only a git-excluded file.
|   platform    Platform starters: write a platform into .ai/platforms/<name>/ for the team to edit. Writes once.
|   release     Release lines from project.release_lines. Reads git only.
|   spec        Feature specs (PRD and TRD) in the knowledge repo: scaffold, lint, revise and status. Never runs git write commands.
|   sync        Render rules, roles, skills, guard and hooks for the agents in .ai/project.yaml.
|   verify      Helpers for the verify workflow.
|   worktree    One worktree per parallel task. Never commits, pushes or deletes a branch.
| 
| Run "dashcrew help <command>" for more information about a command.

=== step 6: dashcrew "help" "init"
exit: 0
stdout:
| Detect the platform and stack and write .ai/project.yaml. Writes nothing else.
| 
| Usage: dashcrew init [arguments]
| -h, --help       Print this usage information.
| -p, --project    Project root.
|                  (defaults to ".")
| -y, --yes        Write the detected profile without asking.
|     --agents     Agents to render for.
|                  [claude-code (default), codex, antigravity]
|     --force      Replace an existing .ai/project.yaml.
| 
| Run "dashcrew help" to see global options.
stderr: (empty)
files: (unchanged)

=== step 7: dashcrew "help" "sync"
exit: 0
stdout:
| Render rules, roles, skills, guard and hooks for the agents in .ai/project.yaml.
| 
| Usage: dashcrew sync [arguments]
| -h, --help                  Print this usage information.
| -p, --project               Project root holding .ai/project.yaml.
|                             (defaults to ".")
|     --force                 Overwrite generated files that were edited by hand.
|     --adopt                 Keep an existing AGENTS.md as the project block.
|     --[no-]compile-guard    Deprecated, does nothing: hooks run dashcrew guard from PATH.
|     --upgrade               On a release line, take this dashcrew's catalog instead of holding its changes.
|     --after-merge           Render fresh the generated files that carry merge conflict markers or disagree with the lock.
| 
| Run "dashcrew help" to see global options.
stderr: (empty)
files: (unchanged)

| 
| Usage: dashcrew doctor [arguments]
| -h, --help       Print this usage information.
| -p, --project    Project root holding .ai/project.yaml.
|                  (defaults to ".")
|     --fetch      Fetch the knowledge clone and report how many commits it is behind its remote.

=== step 9: dashcrew "help" "check"
exit: 0
stdout:
| Merge gate for a pull request: toolkit current, PR sections present, commits in the pattern. Writes nothing.
| 
| Usage: dashcrew check [arguments]
| -h, --help       Print this usage information.
| -p, --project    Project root holding .ai/project.yaml.
|                  (defaults to ".")
|     --pr-body    File holding the PR description; a pull_request workflow supplies it from the event.
|     --base       Lint the commits of <base>..HEAD; a pull_request workflow supplies the range from the event.
|     --ports      Only check that each fix of an older release line reached the newer one (exit 1 if not).
|     --from       With --ports: the older line (a version, a line branch or main); default every adjacent pair.
|     --to         With --ports: the newer line; default the line after --from.
|     --links      Only check how each dependency in project.links is committed (exit 1 if one is not merged).
| 
| Run "dashcrew help" to see global options.
stderr: (empty)
files: (unchanged)

=== step 10: dashcrew "help" "worktree"
exit: 0
stdout:
| One worktree per parallel task. Never commits, pushes or deletes a branch.
| 
| Usage: dashcrew worktree <subcommand> [arguments]
| -h, --help    Print this usage information.
| 
| Available subcommands:
|   create   Create <branch> from <base> in <repo>.worktrees/<name>, with no upstream and the toolkit linked.
|   link     Add missing toolkit links to a worktree and drop an upstream it should not have.
|   list     Show each task worktree: branch, base, upstream, dirty lines, missing links.
|   remove   Remove a clean worktree. The branch is kept.
|   watch    Print one line per new event (commit, pushed, pr, base-moved, merge-tree, overlap) until done.
| 
| Run "dashcrew help" to see global options.
stderr: (empty)
files: (unchanged)

=== step 11: dashcrew "help" "worktree" "create"
exit: 0
stdout:
| Create <branch> from <base> in <repo>.worktrees/<name>, with no upstream and the toolkit linked.
| 
| Usage: dashcrew worktree create <branch> <base>
| -h, --help        Print this usage information.
| -p, --project     Any folder inside the repository.
|                   (defaults to ".")
|     --name        Folder name; defaults to the branch with / replaced by -.
|     --[no-]pub    Run the platform's deps command (platform.commands.deps) in the new worktree.
|                   (defaults to on)
| 
| Run "dashcrew help" to see global options.
stderr: (empty)
files: (unchanged)

=== step 12: dashcrew "help" "guard"
exit: 0
stdout:
| Check one agent tool call: hook JSON on stdin, the answer on stdout or stderr and in the exit code.
| Hooks run it through .ai/bin/guard. The policy is <policy>, else .ai/guard.json in the hook's working directory.
| 
| Usage: dashcrew guard [<policy>]
| -h, --help    Print this usage information.
| 
| Run "dashcrew help" to see global options.
stderr: (empty)
files: (unchanged)

|     --state-dir    Where seen events are kept; defaults to <git dir>/dashcrew-watch.

|   init        Detect the platform and stack and write .ai/project.yaml. Writes nothing else.
|   knowledge   Shared product knowledge: scaffold the repo, keep its clone current, review proposals, find stale pages.
|   link        Point a dependency in project.links at a local checkout. Writes only a git-excluded file.
|   platform    Platform starters: write a platform into .ai/platforms/<name>/ for the team to edit. Writes once.
|   release     Release lines from project.release_lines. Reads git only.
|   spec        Feature specs (PRD and TRD) in the knowledge repo: scaffold, lint, revise and status. Never runs git write commands.
|   sync        Render rules, roles, skills, guard and hooks for the agents in .ai/project.yaml.
|   verify      Helpers for the verify workflow.
|   worktree    One worktree per parallel task. Never commits, pushes or deletes a branch.
| 
| Run "dashcrew help <command>" for more information about a command.
